hook.line: Most people don't realize you can run Claude Code on your computer for free, with no rate limits.
hook.visual: Close-up face, pixel-style orange 'CLAUDE CODE' logo top, orange title 'How to Get Claude Code for FREE', one-word captions on chest.

beats.what: Free-Claude-Code claim under a pixel 'CLAUDE CODE' badge and orange title
Cut to series branding: 'Day 15 of the Valuable AI Series' title
Step 1: Ollama website screenshot pinned above his face
Step 2 title card: download the right AI models
Model page screenshot (qwen3-coder-next) above the face
Second screenshot for the lighter qwen2.5-coder option
Step 3 title: set environment variables to point to Ollama
Orange banner: comment 'Llama' and get the full setup guide
Closes on a follow ask, face only

why_it_works: Free plus 'zero rate limits' answers a cost pain the Claude Code audience already feels, in the first sentence.
A numbered three-step promise with 'Step N' orange title cards tells the viewer how far along they are.
Comment-a-keyword for the guide turns the payoff into comments (1,785) and shares.
Series framing ('Day 15') signals there are more like it, which supports the follow ask.
weaknesses: Shots run about 12 s with only 6 cuts in 86 s; long stretches are a static face.
Steps are named, not shown: the env-variable step has no screen recording, so viewers need the guide.
Two CTAs at the end (comment, then follow) split the ask.
for_robert: Use numbered 'Step N' title cards so viewers track progress; Fred could hold up each step number as it lands. Avoid stacking two CTAs at the end.
